 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/) from the repository root:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pytest
+```
+
+Useful variations:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py   # a single test file
+python3 -m pytest -k reconcile            # tests matching a name
+python3 -m pytest -v                      # verbose output
+```
+
+If pytest is not installed, install it first with `python3 -m pip install pytest`.
